stem: Priya places her hands on her ribs while breathing deeply during a school yoga class. She notices her ribs move up and outwards and her diaphragm moves down. What will happen next?

options.text: Air is forced out of her lungs.
Air is drawn into her lungs.

teacher.key_rationale: Ribs up and out plus diaphragm down increases chest space, so air is drawn in (inhalation). A describes exhalation, C is the opposite of what happens, and D contradicts the given diaphragm movement.
